description:
This 2025 Hyundai Elantra SEL Sport delivers reliable performance and practical features designed for daily driving. With its sleek gray exterior and thoughtfully equipped interior, this sedan offers excellent value for drivers seeking dependability and comfort.

- Carpeted floor mats
- Cargo net
- Reversible cargo tray
- First aid kit
- Mudguards
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto compatibility
- Front dual zone automatic temperature control
- Leather steering wheel
- Fully automatic headlights with delay-off function
- Exterior parking camera rear
- 17-inch alloy wheels
- Dual front and side impact airbags
- Premium cloth seat trim
- Telescoping and tilt steering wheel
- Electronic stability control with traction control

The Elantra SEL Sport combines efficient performance with practical conveniences. Its four-cylinder engine paired with a continuously variable transmission delivers 30 mpg in the city and 39 mpg on the highway, making it an economical choice for both commuting and longer drives. Power steering, speed control, and speed-sensing steering provide responsive handling and control in various driving conditions. The fully automatic headlights with delay-off functionality enhance visibility and safety during low-light conditions.

Inside, you'll find a comfortable and well-appointed cabin. The leather steering wheel and premium cloth seat trim create an inviting environment, while the front center armrest adds convenience for daily driving. Dual front zone automatic temperature control allows both driver and passenger to set preferred comfort levels. The 6-speaker AM/FM/HD display audio system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keeps you connected and entertained, with steering wheel-mounted audio controls letting you adjust settings without taking your eyes off the road.

Safety is prioritized with a comprehensive suite of features. This vehicle includes dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, a rear side impact airbag, and an overhead airbag for occupant protection. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to enhance stopping power and traction. A security system, panic alarm, and low tire pressure warning provide additional peace of mind.

Practical touches make everyday driving easier. The reversible cargo tray and cargo net help organize and secure items in the trunk, while the first aid kit provides emergency supplies. *This 2018 Chevrolet Cruze LT has a great Carfax that shows 16 service records! *

Experience the practicality and efficiency of this 2018 Chevrolet Cruze LT Auto sedan, finished in sleek Satin Steel Metallic with a Jet Black interior. With just 93,928 miles, this used vehicle offers a reliable ride, combining great fuel economy with modern technology. Powered by a 1.4L turbocharged four-cylinder engine producing 153 horsepower and 177 lb-ft of torque, it features a smooth 6-speed shiftable automatic transmission and front-wheel drive for confident handling. The Cruze s fuel efficiency is impressive, delivering 29 mpg in the city and 40 mpg on the highway, making it an economical choice for daily commuting and longer trips. Its four-door design comfortably seats five passengers, making it a versatile sedan for families or individuals seeking style and practicality.

This Chevrolet Cruze LT Auto is equipped with a suite of advanced features designed to enhance your driving experience. Apple CarPlay seamlessly integrates your iPhone for easy access to apps, maps, and messages. The backup camera and blind spot monitor boost safety during lane changes and parking, while Bluetooth connectivity keeps you connected on the go. Satellite radio readiness and a Wi-Fi hotspot ensure entertainment and connectivity wherever your journey takes you. The 7-inch touch screen infotainment system provides easy control over media and settings, complemented by six speakers delivering clear sound. Whether you're navigating city streets or highway routes, this Cruze offers a blend of technology and comfort to keep you engaged and secure.

==== 2018 Chevrolet Cruze Safety and Security Features ====

The Cruze includes a rear seat reminder to encourage safe passenger checks, along with dual front knee airbags and 4-wheel anti-lock braking system (ABS) for enhanced safety. Power door locks with anti-lockout feature prevent accidental lock-ins, while a programmable safety key allows you to set security preferences, providing added peace of mind for your vehicle and its occupants.

==== 2018 Chevrolet Cruze Entertainment and Technology Features ====

Entertainment is central in this Cruze, with a voice-operated radio and a 7-inch touchscreen display for intuitive control. Pandora and Stitcher internet radio apps offer a variety of streaming options, while auxiliary USB input allows for personalized playlists. Electronic messaging assistance, both voice-operated and with a read function, keeps you connected without distraction. Six speakers deliver quality sound, ensuring an enjoyable experience whether you're commuting or on a road trip.

==== 2018 Chevrolet Cruze Performance Features ====

The Cruze features auto start/stop technology, which helps improve fuel efficiency by shutting down the engine during stops and restarting it when needed. This feature contributes to lower emissions and better economy, making the vehicle both environmentally friendly and budget-conscious for everyday driving.

*Vehicle Details*
2019 CADILLAC ESCALADE PREMIUM LUXURY

Few vehicles communicate arrival quite like an Escalade. The 2019 Cadillac Escalade Premium Luxury combines unmistakable presence, genuine full-size SUV capability, three-row versatility, and a richly appointed cabin in a package created for buyers who expect their vehicle to make both travel and everyday life more comfortable. With 86,316 miles, this Premium Pre-Owned Escalade represents an opportunity to own one of America's most recognizable luxury SUVs at a compelling pre-owned value.

Its character begins with Cadillac's 6.2-liter V8 producing 420 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque, paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel drive. Those numbers translate into the effortless power a vehicle of this size deserves. Highway merging requires little drama, passing power is readily available, and the generous torque makes the Escalade particularly well suited to carrying passengers, luggage, and the demands of a busy Texas lifestyle.

PREMIUM LUXURY WITH REAL PRESENCE

The Premium Luxury trim sits appropriately high in the Escalade range, adding meaningful comfort, technology, and driver-assistance equipment rather than luxury in name alone.

Inside, the Escalade delivers the spacious, elevated environment that helped define the modern American luxury SUV. Premium materials, generous passenger accommodations, second-row bucket seating, and three-row versatility make it equally appropriate for an executive, business owner, growing family, or frequent traveler.

Cadillac equipped the Premium Luxury with features including a reconfigurable head-up display, power sunroof, Rear Camera Mirror, Surround Vision, heated and ventilated front seating, heated second-row seating, and rear-seat entertainment. The result is a cabin designed not simply to transport passengers, but to make the time spent traveling considerably more enjoyable.

The rear-seat entertainment system is especially valuable for families and long-distance travelers, while the head-up display places important driving information directly within the driver's natural field of vision. These are features that continue to matter long after the novelty of a new vehicle wears off.

Outside, 22-inch wheels and distinctive Escalade proportions give the Premium Luxury the commanding presence buyers expect from Cadillac's flagship SUV. This is not a vehicle that disappears into traffic. It has an unmistakable identity whether arriving at a business meeting in San Antonio or heading west into the Texas Hill Country.

POWER DESIGNED FOR A FULL-SIZE LUXURY SUV

A vehicle with the Escalade's size and mission needs an engine with substantial reserves, and the 6.2-liter V8 provides exactly that.

Its 420 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque provide the relaxed strength that makes a full-size luxury SUV enjoyable on the open road. The 10-speed automatic transmission offers a broad range of gearing, helping the Escalade deliver smooth acceleration while keeping the V8 in an effective portion of its powerband.

Cadillac also equipped the Escalade with Magnetic Ride Control, technology designed to continually respond to changing road conditions and help balance ride comfort with vehicle control.
